from pydantic import BaseModel from typing import List, Optional from datetime import datetime
class BranchScore(BaseModel): branch_name: str average_score: float evaluation_count: int region: Optional[str] = None
class MonthlyTrend(BaseModel): year: int month: int month_name: str average_score: float evaluation_count: int
class ReportFilter(BaseModel): start_date: Optional[datetime] = None end_date: Optional[datetime] = None project_id: Optional[str] = None branch_id: Optional[str] = None region: Optional[str] = None
class ReportData(BaseModel): title: str subtitle: str date_range: str total_evaluations: int average_score: float top_branches: List[BranchScore] bottom_branches: List[BranchScore] monthly_trends: List[MonthlyTrend] branch_comparisons: List[BranchScore] filters: ReportFilter

Step.Title: Chart Generator - Matplotlib
Step.Code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt import matplotlib matplotlib.use('Agg') # Backend for non-GUI import io from typing import List from models import BranchScore, MonthlyTrend
class ChartGenerator: def __init__(self): # Türkçe karakter desteği plt.rcParams['font.family'] = 'DejaVu Sans' plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False
def generate_monthly_trend_chart(self, trends: List[MonthlyTrend]) -> io.BytesIO: """Aylık trend çizgi grafiği""" fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
months = [f"{t.month_name[:3]} {t.year}" for t in trends] scores = [t.average_score for t in trends]
ax.plot(months, scores, marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='#1f77b4') ax.fill_between(range(len(months)), scores, alpha=0.3, color='#1f77b4')
ax.set_xlabel('Ay', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold') ax.set_ylabel('Ortalama Puan (%)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold') ax.set_title('Aylık Performans Trendi', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=20) ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--') ax.set_ylim(0, 100)
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right') plt.tight_layout()
# BytesIO'ya kaydet buffer = io.BytesIO() plt.savefig(buffer, format='png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight') buffer.seek(0) plt.close(fig) return buffer
def generate_branch_comparison_chart(self, branches: List[BranchScore], top_n: int = 10) -> io.BytesIO: """Şube karşılaştırma bar grafiği""" fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 8))
# En iyi N şubeyi al sorted_branches = sorted(branches, key=lambda x: x.average_score, reverse=True)[:top_n]
branch_names = [b.branch_name for b in sorted_branches] scores = [b.average_score for b in sorted_branches]
# Renk gradyanı (en iyi yeşil, en kötü kırmızı) colors = plt.cm.RdYlGn([s/100 for s in scores])
bars = ax.barh(branch_names, scores, color=colors, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
# Bar üzerine değer yaz for i, (bar, score) in enumerate(zip(bars, scores)): ax.text(score + 1, i, f'{score:.1f}%', va='center', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xlabel('Ortalama Puan (%)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold') ax.set_title(f'Şube Performans Karşılaştırması (Top {top_n})', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=20) ax.set_xlim(0, 110) ax.grid(True, axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
plt.tight_layout()
buffer = io.BytesIO() plt.savefig(buffer, format='png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight') buffer.seek(0) plt.close(fig) return buffer
def generate_top_bottom_chart(self, top_branches: List[BranchScore], bottom_branches: List[BranchScore]) -> io.BytesIO: """En iyi ve en kötü şubeler karşılaştırması""" fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 6))
# En iyi şubeler top_names = [b.branch_name for b in top_branches] top_scores = [b.average_score for b in top_branches] ax1.barh(top_names, top_scores, color='#2ecc71', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5) ax1.set_title('En Yüksek Puanlı Şubeler', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold') ax1.set_xlim(0, 100) for i, score in enumerate(top_scores): ax1.text(score + 2, i, f'{score:.1f}%', va='center', fontsize=9)
# En kötü şubeler bottom_names = [b.branch_name for b in bottom_branches] bottom_scores = [b.average_score for b in bottom_branches] ax2.barh(bottom_names, bottom_scores, color='#e74c3c', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5) ax2.set_title('En Düşük Puanlı Şubeler', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold') ax2.set_xlim(0, 100) for i, score in enumerate(bottom_scores): ax2.text(score + 2, i, f'{score:.1f}%', va='center', fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout()
buffer = io.BytesIO() plt.savefig(buffer, format='png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight') buffer.seek(0) plt.close(fig) return buffer
def generate_regional_comparison_chart(self, branches: List[BranchScore]) -> io.BytesIO: """Bölgesel karşılaştırma (pie chart)""" fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 8))
# Bölgelere göre grupla region_data = {} for branch in branches: region = branch.region or "Belirtilmemiş" if region not in region_data: region_data[region] = {"count": 0, "total_score": 0} region_data[region]["count"] += 1 region_data[region]["total_score"] += branch.average_score
# Ortalama hesapla region_averages = { region: data["total_score"] / data["count"] for region, data in region_data.items() }
labels = list(region_averages.keys()) sizes = list(region_averages.values()) colors = plt.cm.Set3(range(len(labels)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax.pie( sizes, labels=labels, autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors, textprops={'fontsize': 11, 'weight': 'bold'} )
ax.set_title('Bölgesel Performans Dağılımı', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=20)
plt.tight_layout()
buffer = io.BytesIO() plt.savefig(buffer, format='png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight') buffer.seek(0) plt.close(fig) return buffer

Step.Title: PowerPoint Builder
Step.Code:
from pptx import Presentation from pptx.util import Inches, Pt from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor from models import ReportData from .chart_generator import ChartGenerator import io
class PowerPointBuilder: def __init__(self): self.prs = Presentation() self.prs.slide_width = Inches(10) self.prs.slide_height = Inches(7.5) self.chart_gen = ChartGenerator()
def create_title_slide(self, title: str, subtitle: str, date_range: str): """Kapak slaytı""" slide = self.prs.slides.add_slide(self.prs.slide_layouts[6]) # Blank layout
# Başlık title_box = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(1), Inches(2), Inches(8), Inches(1.5)) title_frame = title_box.text_frame title_frame.text = title title_frame.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(44) title_frame.paragraphs[0].font.bold = True title_frame.paragraphs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor(31, 78, 120) title_frame.paragraphs[0].alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
# Alt başlık subtitle_box = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(1), Inches(4), Inches(8), Inches(1)) subtitle_frame = subtitle_box.text_frame subtitle_frame.text = subtitle subtitle_frame.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(24) subtitle_frame.paragraphs[0].alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
# Tarih aralığı date_box = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(1), Inches(5.5), Inches(8), Inches(0.5)) date_frame = date_box.text_frame date_frame.text = date_range date_frame.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(16) date_frame.paragraphs[0].alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER date_frame.paragraphs[0].font.italic = True
def create_summary_slide(self, total_evaluations: int, average_score: float): """Özet slaytı""" slide = self.prs.slides.add_slide(self.prs.slide_layouts[5]) # Title only
title = slide.shapes.title title.text = "Genel Özet"
# KPI kutuları left = Inches(2) top = Inches(2.5) width = Inches(3) height = Inches(2)
# Toplam değerlendirme eval_box = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height) eval_frame = eval_box.text_frame eval_frame.text = f"{total_evaluations}\n\nToplam Değerlendirme" eval_frame.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(48) eval_frame.paragraphs[0].font.bold = True eval_frame.paragraphs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor(46, 134, 193) eval_frame.paragraphs[0].alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
# Ortalama puan score_box = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left + Inches(3.5), top, width, height) score_frame = score_box.text_frame score_frame.text = f"{average_score:.1f}%\n\nOrtalama Puan" score_frame.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(48) score_frame.paragraphs[0].font.bold = True score_frame.paragraphs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor(46, 204, 113) score_frame.paragraphs[0].alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
def add_chart_slide(self, title: str, chart_image: io.BytesIO): """Grafik slaytı""" slide = self.prs.slides.add_slide(self.prs.slide_layouts[5])
slide_title = slide.shapes.title slide_title.text = title
# Grafiği ekle left = Inches(0.5) top = Inches(1.5) width = Inches(9) height = Inches(5.5)
slide.shapes.add_picture(chart_image, left, top, width=width, height=height)
def build(self, data: ReportData) -> io.BytesIO: """Tüm raporu oluştur""" # 1. Kapak slaytı self.create_title_slide(data.title, data.subtitle, data.date_range)
# 2. Özet slaytı self.create_summary_slide(data.total_evaluations, data.average_score)
# 3. Aylık trend grafiği if data.monthly_trends: trend_chart = self.chart_gen.generate_monthly_trend_chart(data.monthly_trends) self.add_chart_slide("Aylık Performans Trendi", trend_chart)
# 4. Top/Bottom şubeler if data.top_branches and data.bottom_branches: top_bottom_chart = self.chart_gen.generate_top_bottom_chart( data.top_branches, data.bottom_branches ) self.add_chart_slide("En İyi ve En Kötü Performans", top_bottom_chart)
# 5. Şube karşılaştırması if data.branch_comparisons: comparison_chart = self.chart_gen.generate_branch_comparison_chart(data.branch_comparisons) self.add_chart_slide("Şube Karşılaştırması", comparison_chart)
# 6. Bölgesel analiz if data.branch_comparisons: regional_chart = self.chart_gen.generate_regional_comparison_chart(data.branch_comparisons) self.add_chart_slide("Bölgesel Performans Dağılımı", regional_chart)
# BytesIO'ya kaydet ppt_buffer = io.BytesIO() self.prs.save(ppt_buffer) ppt_buffer.seek(0) return ppt_buffer
